# Assessment Facts Overview

This directory contains supplementary analysis documents for the versioned application assessment.

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | Summarizes the application layers, external services, and key component relationships. |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Maps declared package dependencies, compatibility concerns, and test dependencies. |
| [API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | Inventories application routes, request/response contracts, and communication patterns. |
| [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](data-architecture.md) | Documents the SQL data model, persistence services, caching, and data boundaries. |
| [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Lists configuration sources, runtime options, feature flags, and secret provisioning. |
| [Core Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | Describes catalog entities, user workflows, and business rules. |
